description: This file defines the IAVInput interface for the WPEFramework project, containing declarations of methods, structures, and notifications related to audio/video input management, device events, and configuration in the system.

classes.name: IAVInput
classes.description: Interface for managing AV input sources, notifications, and configurations within WPEFramework.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the AV input device with the provided service shell.

methods.name: RegisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for device connection/disconnection events.

methods.name: UnregisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters the device change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for signal change events.

methods.name: UnregisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters the signal change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for input status change events.

methods.name: UnregisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters the input status change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for video stream info update events.

methods.name: UnregisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters the video stream info update notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for game feature status update events.

methods.name: UnregisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters the game feature status update notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for AV content type update events.

methods.name: UnregisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters the AV content type update notification callback.

methods.name: NumberOfInputs
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available AV input sources.

methods.name: WriteEDID
methods.description: Writes a new EDID value to a specified port.

methods.name: ReadEDID
methods.description: Reads the current EDID value from a specified port.

methods.name: GetRawSPD
methods.description: Retrieves the raw SPD infoFrame data for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: GetSPD
methods.description: Retrieves the SPD infoFrame data for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: SetEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a specified port.

methods.name: GetEdidVersion
methods.description: Gets the current EDID version for a specified port.

methods.name: SetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Sets the ALLM support bit in EDID for a specified port.

methods.name: GetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Gets the current ALLM support bit in EDID for a specified port.

methods.name: SetVRRSupport
methods.description: Sets the VRR support bit in EDID for a specified port.

methods.name: GetVRRSupport
methods.description: Gets the VRR support bit in EDID for a specified port.

methods.name: GetHdmiVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum HDMI version supported for a port.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets the audio mixer levels.

methods.name: StartInput
methods.description: Activates a specified input port as the primary source.

methods.name: StopInput
methods.description: Deactivates the current primary input port.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Defines the position and size of the video window.

methods.name: CurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current video mode for an input device.

methods.name: ContentProtected
methods.description: Indicates whether content is protected (e.g., HDCP) on an input device.

methods.name: GetSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Returns a list of supported game features.

methods.name: GetGameFeatureStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a specific game feature, e.g., ALLM.

methods.name: GetVRRFrameRate
methods.description: Gets the current VRR frame rate for a port.
